messages:
Alice Miller: Quick heads-up — we're landing an audit-event schema update (v1.3) to staging today. There are a few renames and additions that affect customer validation and docs. Tagging @Sophie (Docs), @Ben (Support), @Raj (Product) for visibility.

Raj Patel: ETA on prod rollout? any migration steps customers must take?

Alice Miller: Planning a staged rollout: staging -> canary next week -> broad rollout in two weeks. We’ll provide a compatibility shim in our ingest layer for 30 days to map old field names. Customers who validate strict schemas will need to update within that window.

Sophie (Docs): Can you send a concise diff and sample payloads? I need clear acceptance criteria for customer-facing validation docs and a changelog blurb.

Alice Miller: Yup. High level changes:
- `actor_id` renamed to `principal.id` (nested object).
- `event_type` values normalized (e.g., `kms.rotate` -> `kms.key.rotate`).
- new `resource_chain` (array) to represent hierarchical resources.
- `kms_key_id` added for KMS operations (nullable).
- `audit_level` enumerated; default `info` for non-admin events.
Shim behavior: incoming old names accepted and translated for 30 days; we log warning-level audit events when a legacy name is used.

Ben (Support): Customers with SIEM ingestion need sample mapping (Splunk/Datadog/QRadar). Also want a short customer-friendly FAQ: "What changed? Do I need to take action?"

Alice Miller: Agreed. We'll produce:
- sample pack (per-SIEM example payloads)
- a JSON->CSV mapping guide for common SIEM pipelines
- an acceptance test checklist (examples + regex to match new event_type values)

Sophie (Docs): Example payload pls (I’ll drop it into the samples repo):
```
{
  "timestamp": "2026-05-12T15:23:01Z",
  "event_type": "kms.key.rotate",
  "principal": {"id": "user-123", "type": "service_account"},
  "resource_chain": ["org/abc", "project/payments", "key/stripe-prod"],
  "kms_key_id": "projects/xyz/locations/us/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key1",
  "metadata": {"client_ip": "54.12.34.56"}
}
```

Raj Patel: For Dedicated/Private customers, we should offer a bundle: sample pack + migration script + optional extended shim (90d). Also flag in Console when legacy names are seen.

Alice Miller: Good call. We'll propose 90d extended shim as an opt-in for Private deployments. For Hosted, default 30d.

KMS-Bot: Note: KMS integration events will include `kms_key_id` only when operation touches customer-managed keys. Non-customer keys will omit the field.

Sophie (Docs): I'll draft: one-pager summary, changelog entry, sample pack README, and a "how to validate" checklist (regex + example asserts). Need final diff by EOD tomorrow.

Ben (Support): Can we get a short Slack-friendly blurb for customer comms? Support needs one-liner + link to samples.

Alice Miller: Draft blurb: "We updated the audit event schema to improve resource modeling and KMS traceability. We provide a 30-day compatibility shim; sample payloads and migration guidance are available here: https://redwood.example.com/audit-samples. Contact support for extended compatibility options."

Raj Patel: Also add a note to release notes about RBAC mapping changes: `role` is unchanged, but `actor_id`->`principal.id` affects a few existing RBAC audit rules.

Sophie (Docs): Will include RBAC impact section and a minimal acceptance test suite for customers to run locally.

deploy-bot: schema-service: deployed branch `audit-schema/v1.3` to staging (build 4821) — smoke tests passed.

Alice Miller: Thanks team. Action items: Sophie: docs + samples (EOD tomorrow). Ben: prepare support blurb and SIEM mapping checklist. Raj: confirm Private shim SLA/offer. I’ll own final sample pack and the migration script. I'll post the diff in this thread once ready.

Ben (Support): Copy that. I'll prep a short customer comms template for account teams.

Sophie (Docs): On it — will ping when draft is live for review.

Alice Miller: Leaving a note: security will run vuln triage on any ingestion changes; if we detect anomalies during shim period we auto-disable shim for that customer and notify account.

Raj Patel: Good safety measure. Thanks all.
